 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 12/12/2024 These applications for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. (483 BNSS) have been filed by the petitioners who have been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.268/2024 registered at Police Station Chopasni Housing Board, Jodhpur City West, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 201 of IPC.
Heard learned counsel parties.

sentences.text: Perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that as per the prosecution, the petitioners had sold a residential plot no.2, Sector B, Pal Road, Jodhpur by executing a sale agreement, on the basis of the fake Power of Attorney.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the challan papers and other documents attached with the case file, learned counsel submitted that initially as per the prosecution, a fake Power of Attorney bearing signatures of Aparajita Kaushik got prepared by one Jagdish.
Jagdish by using aforesaid Power of Attorney sold the plot in question to one Dinesh Chouhan.
Thereafter, Dinesh Chouhan sold the plot in question to petitioner- Babu Singh and one Bhanwar Singh Rajpurohit.
According to the learned counsel, the petitioner- Babu Singh was a bona fide purchaser of the plot as he had purchased the same from one Dinesh Chouhan.

Learned counsel submitted that the documents available on record clearly indicate that the fake Power of Attorney relating to the plot in question was prepared in the year 2011 by one Jagdish S/o Chandmal, who has already expired.

There is nothing on record to [2024:RJ-JD:51260] (3 of 4)
[CRLMB-10426/2024] indicate that the petitioners have played any role in creation of fake Power of Attorney in the year 2011.

The only allegation against the petitioners is that when it came into their knowledge that they have came into possession of the plot in question on the basis of a fake Power of Attorney, they instead of initiating proceedings for cancellation of the same, had sold the plot to one Baya Devi.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that the as per the prosecution, a fake Power of Attorney under the fake and forged signature of the owner of the plot namely Aparajita Kaushik was prepared by one Jagdish S/o Chandmal, who has already expired and the investigation against the petitioners has already been completed.

The property in question belonging to the complainant was transferred in the name of subsequent purchasers on the basis of the fake Power of Attorney prepared by Jagdish S/o [2024:RJ-JD:51260]
(4 of 4) [CRLMB-10426/2024] Chandmal; no recovery is due to be made from the present petitioners and the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioners are triable by a Court of Magistrate.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail applications filed by the petitioners deserve to be accepted.
Consequently, these bail applications under Section 439 Cr.P.C. 439 Cr.P.C. (483 BNSS) are allowed.

It is ordered that the accused- petitioners (1) Babu Singh S/o Shri Pratap Singh, (2)
Radheshyam Tapariya S/o Late Shri Tarachand and (3) Dinesh Chouhan S/o Late Shri Pukhraj Ji Chouhan arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.268/2024 registered at Police Station Chopasni Housing Board, Jodhpur City West, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case,
provided each of them furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for their appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.
A copy of this order be placed in each file.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 217-219 divya/-
